title: Best Areas in Islamabad for Short Stays in 2026
excerpt: From F-7 for business to G-8 for medical travelers — find the best sector for your needs in Islamabad.
author: Kor Da Team
body:
Islamabad is a planned city with distinct sectors serving different needs. Here's our guide:

**F-7 Markaz** — Best for: Business travelers, diplomats. Premium dining, shopping at Jinnah Super, close to diplomatic enclave.

**F-11** — Best for: Modern living. Newer apartments with Margalla Hills views. Great WiFi, quieter than central sectors.

**G-8** — Best for: Medical travelers. Walking distance to PIMS Hospital. Affordable guest houses and apartments.

**E-11** — Best for: University visitors. Near NUST, FAST. Affordable studios and 1-bed apartments.

**DHA Islamabad** — Best for: Families. Gated community, secure, parks, great amenities.

**Blue Area** — Best for: Business. Corporate hub with luxury apartments and serviced flats.

title: Why Short Stays in Islamabad Are Better Than Hotels
excerpt: Fully equipped kitchens, more space, privacy, and lower cost. Here's why furnished short stays are replacing hotels for business travelers and families.
author: Kor Da Team
body:
Islamabad has seen a rapid shift from traditional hotels to short-stay apartments and guest houses. Here's why:

**More Space** — A typical hotel room offers 250-400 sq ft. A short-stay apartment gives you a full living room, bedroom, kitchen, and often a balcony.

**Full Kitchen** — Cook your own meals. Save money on eating out. Especially important for families with children or medical travelers.

**Privacy** — Entire apartment to yourself. No shared corridors, no noisy neighbors, no housekeeping interruptions.

**PKR Pricing** — Pay in Pakistani Rupees. No USD conversion, no hidden foreign transaction fees.

**Verified Hosts** — Every Kor Da host is CNIC-verified via NADRA Verisys. You know exactly who you're booking from.
